edge_tables.description: One per relation, in the order the compiled schema lists them.

format.description: The format the corpus is written in.

vertex_tables.description: One per vertex type, in the order the compiled schema lists them.

ColumnRole.description:
What a column IS — never what a reader does with it.

A reader that used to carry a list now names the roles it means. It is data in `fossil.json` too: a writer column's `role` in its table's `properties`, spelled as the variant in lowercase.

oneOf.description: The row's rank in the ordering, which a new subject renumbers.
What a bookmark keys on, and what survives a rebuild.
One end of a relation, a vertex's global `dense_id`.

destination.description: The column holding the destination vertex's `dense_id`, and its table.

iri.description: The relation's IRI, when the program's shape document gives one.

name.description: `<Src>_<label>_<Dst>`, unique: the label repeats across relations.

path.description: The table's Parquet file, relative to the corpus root.

properties.description: Every column of the file, in file order.

source.description: The column holding the source vertex's `dense_id`, and its table.

references.description: The vertex table whose `key` it holds.

iri.description: The predicate IRI the program mapped it from, when there is one.

name.description: The column name, as in the Parquet schema.

nullable.description: Whether a row may hold no value. Absent is `false`.

role.description: What the column IS, for a column the writer emits — `corpus.bnf`'s role, so a reader names the roles it means rather than the names it remembers. Absent on a column of the program's.

type.description: Its type, in the spelling [`data_type_name`] writes.

identity.description: The identity column: `subject`, unique within the table.

iri.description: The type's IRI, when the program's shape document gives one.

key.description: The key column: `dense_id`, global and gapless across every vertex table, and one contiguous range of it per table, in manifest order.

name.description: The type's label: the name of the table and its PGQ label.

path.description: The table's Parquet file, relative to the corpus root.

properties.description: Every column of the file, in file order.
